blocks.translation:
• This product contains electronic components; if you use a pacemaker, do not bring this product close to your body.
• Do not insert fingers or other objects into gaps of moving parts. There is a risk of being caught and injured.
• Do not continue to stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause you to feel unwell.
• Do not play roughly, such as by hitting or swinging the product.
• If batteries are misused there is a risk of heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following cautions.
• Batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, consult a physician immediately. Battery replacement must be performed by a guardian.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the +/− (plus/minus) polarity set correctly.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If a battery is swallowed or battery fluid gets into the eyes, consult a physician immediately. If leaked fluid gets on the skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local municipality’s disposal instructions.
• Do not lick or put button batteries in the mouth.
• After playing, be sure to turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
